comment: Cite contents properly throughout the manuscript.
response: We rebuilt the revised bibliography from inspected primary records, distinguished preprint versions, and removed unsupported novelty and release claims. Historical references remain preserved; their unresolved status is documented.

experiment: Audit all 27,000 images, channels, class counts and duplicate hashes
issue: RGB versus multispectral description and split provenance
response: We cited EuroSAT, identified the local RGB representation, and documented counts, preprocessing and the preserved random split. File/pixel hashes found no exact overlap. The original release version and geographic independence remain unverified and are stated as limitations.

experiment: Deterministic metric and edge-case tests; real-data evaluation
response: We supplied formulas, inputs, ranges, directions, normalizations, edge cases and limitations. Macro-F1 is distinct from historical weighted F1. Calibration, uncertainty, stability, deletion faithfulness and representation are not treated as interchangeable.

experiment: Match limitations to verified input and training audit
issue: Overgeneralization beyond EuroSAT and experimental design
response: We expanded limitations covering land-cover labels, patch-level decisions, random splits, missing real shifts, small architecture/seed scope, masking artifacts, correlated pillars, weighting, feature geometry and pretraining differences. Crop-health uses are future applications requiring dedicated evidence.
test: scope and discrepancy checks in manuscript validator

experiment: Generate figures from validated prediction and explanation artifacts
response: The generator produces performance, six-pillar and diagnostic figures with source run IDs and data sidecars. Original unsupported figures are preserved but excluded. Full-campaign graphics remain contingent on completion of the declared experiment matrix; smoke figures are explicitly labelled.
test: figure hashes, source hashes and table consistency

issue: Missing contextual comparisons and exaggerated novelty
response: We added a literature comparison covering EuroSAT, foundation models, XAI evaluation, calibration, corruption robustness and TorchGeo. Published scores are not pooled with local experiments. We explain protocol differences and limit the contribution to auditable integration.
test: verified source registry and citation checks

experiment: End-to-end real-data smoke run with saved artifacts
response: We documented and diagrammed the actual data, model, training, explanation, score and reporting path. The unified CLI uses tested components. Legacy prototypes are not represented as executed research; JSON and additive SQLite records preserve configurations, hashes, artifacts and failures.

comment: Compare the proposed work with published work.
experiment: Same targeted review as R1.6, with explicit fairness statement
issue: Need fair comparison with related research
response: We added the comparison and fairness paragraph, distinguish methodological literature from controlled same-protocol runs, and make no unexecuted baseline or superiority claim.

comment: Resolve Figure 7/Table 1 inconsistency: ResNet-18 test accuracy 91.53% versus validation accuracy around 84-86%.
experiment: Read both SQLite stores; inspect original figure, logs and checkpoints
issue: Unrecoverable epoch history and mixed legacy aggregation
response: We reproduced the 91.53% legacy aggregate and found that it mixes one- and five-epoch runs with repeated seeds. The original validation curve's source run could not be recovered. Both sources are preserved. We removed the unsupported curve and withdrew the five-independent-seed interpretation rather than inventing a corrected validation value. Historical reconciliation requires the missing logs/checkpoint.
test: legacy grouping and explicit unresolved discrepancy gate

comment: Add standard deviations and 95% confidence intervals.
experiment: Homogeneous independent-seed groups; Student-t mean intervals
issue: Means lacked seed-level uncertainty and consistent replication
response: We implemented sample SD and Student-t intervals with explicit assumptions, run counts and missing counts. Historical runs are separated by epochs and labelled unverified. Full independent-seed intervals await the complete new campaign; one-seed smoke intervals remain NOT COMPUTED.

experiment: Fixed-target noise stability and salient/random/least deletion curves
response: We renamed SSIM as explanation stability and implemented a separate deletion metric with a fixed target, explicit mean-RGB baseline, patch ordering and trapezoidal integration. Random and least-salient controls are retained. The new common attribution rule differs from legacy Grad-CAM and is explicitly documented.

comment: Clarify the composite score and Bayesian terminology.
experiment: Equal/default, alternative profiles and 50 deterministic perturbations
issue: Weighted sum is not Bayesian inference; weighting sensitivity absent
response: We define a Composite Trust Score, fixed normalizations and explicit weights. Missing pillars reject aggregation. Sensitivity code records scores, ranks and correlations; multi-model empirical sensitivity requires completed comparable runs. The score is not represented as a probability.

experiment: Compute all six from saved predictions, deletion curves, corruptions and embeddings
issue: Uncertainty and representation measures were not reported
response: All six components are implemented and exercised on real smoke data. Brier-based probability quality and normalized feature silhouette are defined with limitations. Full benchmark Table 1 and uncertainty require the complete campaign. Real geographic/seasonal OOD remains NOT COMPUTED; synthetic robustness is clearly a proxy.

experiment: Inspect legacy loader and official six-band model card
issue: Actual Prithvi checkpoint and adaptation were not used
response: The active historical loader substituted RGB ViT-Base for Prithvi. We withdrew that result as foundation-model evidence and prohibited proxies. No six-band adaptation can be reconstructed from RGB JPEGs; an actual checkpoint and compatible spectral data are required for a new Prithvi experiment.

comment: Verify whether all models use the same spectral bands.
experiment: Input metadata and shape assertions for supported RGB architectures
response: We provide a model-input audit and enforce RGB B04/B03/B02 with three channels at 224x224 for supported models. Historical input provenance is incomplete and is not retroactively asserted. Prithvi is excluded rather than assigned invented missing bands.

experiment: Claim audit against dataset labels and actual channels
issue: Land-cover evidence does not validate crop disease or health
response: We revised the abstract, introduction, contribution, discussion, limitations and conclusion to RGB land-cover classification. The suggested multispectral wording is not used because the actual inputs are RGB. Crop-health, disease and yield applications are future work requiring dedicated evidence.
